summary: Project registration, listing, and removal are now available without a browser. Commands delegate to the authenticated running user service when its owner-only access record is available, or acquire the controller singleton lock and reuse ControlService directly while the controller is offline.

Registration reuses existing Git and launch-preset detection and can select the first available unconfigured port from 3000 through 3999. Removal respects reservations, stops the owned runtime, releases the project port transactionally, and preserves a controller-level audit record.

The doctor command verifies the supported Node.js runtime, Git availability, application state, and worktree discovery. Human-readable output follows the operating-system locale, while project list --json provides stable automation output.
title: Added headless project management and diagnostics
validation: Automated tests cover offline add/list/remove, invalid repositories, missing development scripts without partial records, free-port selection, reservation safety, port reuse, persistent removal audit, authenticated HTTP removal, and delegation through a live controller access record.
